subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel webhook returns 404 after v2026.5.28 update

question: Should #89184 be closed as covered by the merged LINE account resolver fix #81471, or kept under the gateway/plugin route-lifecycle work tracked by #94572?
rationale: The account-resolution bug is fixed on main, but the issue evidence says the default provider started before the webhook route still returned 404, which source inspection cannot disambiguate without maintainer classification or current-main live proof.

options.title: Keep under route-lifecycle proof
options.body: Keep #89184 open until a current-main or release repro shows whether provider-starts-but-route-404 still follows #94572 after #81471.

options.title: Close as resolver-fixed on main
options.body: Close this as implemented by #81471 if maintainers accept the provider-start line as imprecise or unrelated to the failing curl.

options.title: Defer until release retest
options.body: Wait for the #81471 fix to ship, then ask for a redacted config and `/line/webhook` curl result on that release before deciding.

recommendation.title: Keep under route-lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Keep #89184 open until a current-main or release repro shows whether provider-starts-but-route-404 still follows #94572 after #81471.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the resolver fix that changed whether this issue is already covered, so they are the best available owner for the close-versus-route-lifecycle classification.
